metrics.track: max(0, 1 - err/ref) over 2.0 s to t_end (7.8 s), err the RMS angle between the tracked rotation since the window's start and the commanded one (the trial's w_ref integrated); the replay's object sampled at the tracker's capture times
metrics.twist_end_deg: rotation about z_P from the first tracked sample, at the record's end (8.3 s)
metrics.rise_max_mm: largest rise along z_P from the first sample
metrics.tilt_max_deg: largest tilt from the first sample
metrics.drift_max_mm: largest 3-D distance from the first sample
metrics.twist_trace_rms_deg: RMS of the replay's minus the hand's twist from 2.0 s
metrics.jumps: (largest rise of the twist over 0.2 s from 2.0 s, deg; number of 0.2 s windows rising more than 8.0 deg)
metrics.joint_rms_deg: RMS of the replayed minus the measured joint angle (servo deg) at the read-backs' times: approach 0-0.6 s (free air), grasp 0.6-2.0 s, task from 2.0 s
metrics.joint_bias_task_deg: mean replayed minus measured angle, task window (servo deg)
metrics.object_task: RMS orientation (deg) and position (mm) error against the tracked pose, task window
